title: Debug and fix slider progress persistence system

requirements.text: Debug the backend updateMilestoneProgress method in main.mo to verify it correctly receives milestoneId and progress parameters, properly updates the milestones HashMap, and returns a success response

quotes: no se mueve el slider aun, y dice un mensaje de error 'no se ha podido actualizar el estado'

acceptanceCriteria: The backend updateMilestoneProgress method logs received parameters (milestoneId, progress)
The method successfully finds the milestone in the HashMap using the provided ID
The method updates the milestone's progress field with the new percentage value
The method returns a clear success or error response
Backend logs confirm the update operation completes without errors

constraints: Preserve the existing Milestone and Task data models in backend/main.mo
Do not modify the immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
Maintain the single-actor architecture with all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo
Keep all user-facing text in Spanish
Use the existing stable HashMap storage for milestones
nonGoals: Adding new milestone fields or data structures
Changing the slider UI design or appearance
Implementing batch progress updates for multiple milestones
Adding undo/redo functionality for progress changes
